name: AwakePix
description: Browser-based photo-to-video, text-to-video and AI image creation/editing. Includes prompts, model examples and upfront quotes. Verified accounts can try one free 5s 480p Mini video with audio and no watermark, subject to shared capacity; one free image per device/day, sign-in to download. Free outputs personal/noncommercial. Further creation uses one-time credit packs from US$4.90; commercial use subject to terms and input rights.
